title: Give core-3.x its own version, 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and deploy it
body:
`core-3.x` (the Platform 3.0 line from #44) builds the same version as master, 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and doesn't deploy. The shared workflow deploys only `main`, `master` and `N.x` branches unless `deploy_branch` is set, so run 38076401274 skipped its deploy job, and deploying would have overwritten master's SNAPSHOT anyway. The cohort-api 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT on mavenrepo is therefore master's Platform 2.x build (republished on 2026-10-11 from f2304f8: Java 8, `javax.persistence`). A module built for Platform 3.0 can't use it. In mekomsolutions/openmrs-module-initializer#338, 72 of the api module's 182 tests error, because the session factory fails with "An association from the table 'cohort_attribute' refers to an unmapped class".

This gives `core-3.x` the next major, 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, and adds it to `deploy_branch`. Master keeps 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT, which COH-63 (#37) gave it for Platform 2.7.3 and Java 21 and which hasn't been released. `master` stays in the list so it keeps deploying if this branch is merged into master later.

- With this input, the shared `resolve-maven-deploy-params` step (run locally from openmrs-contrib-gha-workflows main) resolves `["master", "core-3.x"]` for a push to `core-3.x`. Without it, it resolves `["main", "master"]`.
- `mvn clean package` passes on JDK 21 and 25 against the published core 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT (build 437), with 69 api tests and 58 omod tests. The omod's config.xml says 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT.

Modules that need cohort's Platform 3.0 build move to 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT once this deploys, mekomsolutions/openmrs-module-initializer#338 among them.

title: Make the tests pass under surefire 3.6.0 and in any class order
body:
master's Java 21 build fails for two separate reasons.

**Mockito can't self-attach under surefire 3.6.0.** Maven 3.10, now on the GitHub runner image, defaults to surefire 3.6.0. Under it, Mockito's inline mock maker fails with `Could not self-attach to current VM using external process`, and cohort-api gets 48 failures and 14 errors. With the same JDK, code and Maven, surefire 3.5.4 passes and 3.6.0 fails. This loads the Byte Buddy agent with `-javaagent` when the test JVM starts, so nothing has to self-attach (Mockito's documented setup for newer JDKs).

**The omod controller tests depend on class order.** `BaseCohortResourceTest` mocks `RestUtil` statically. If `RestConstants` is first loaded inside one of those tests, its static initializer calls the mocked `RestUtil.setUriPrefix()`, and `URI_PREFIX` stays null for the rest of the JVM. The six controller tests then fail with an NPE in `BaseUriSetup`, on any JDK, whenever a resource test runs first. Under PowerMock each test class had its own classloader, so the mock never leaked. The controller tests now recompute the prefix before each test. Removing the `RestUtil` mock instead breaks the resource tests: `mockStatic(Context.class)` then can't initialize `Context`.

Checked with a clean Maven repository in an `eclipse-temurin` Linux container, Maven 3.10.0, `mvn clean install`:
- **Before:** Java 21 gets 48 failures and 14 errors in api. Java 17 and 21 get 6 errors in omod when the resource tests run first.
- **After:** Java 8, 11, 17 and 21 all pass, with api 62/0/0 and omod 55/0/0.

title: Remove a duplicate dependency declaration so the build passes on Maven 3.10
body:
org.openmrs.api:openmrs-api is declared twice in api/pom.xml, once without a scope and once at compile scope. Maven 3.9 accepted it with a warning; Maven 3.10, now on the GitHub runner image, rejects it and the build fails before it starts. The resolved dependencies are unchanged. 

- `mvn validate` with Maven 3.10.0: fails before this change, passes after.
- `mvn dependency:list` with Maven 3.9.10: the resolved dependencies of every module are identical before and after.

core-3.x already does the same.

title: Upgrade to support OpenMRS Platform 3.0
body:
Updates cohort so it builds against, and runs on, openmrs-core master (Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT: Java 21, Jakarta EE, Spring 7, Hibernate 7). The module version stays at master's 4.0.0-SNAPSHOT. Same approach as the platform 3 upgrades of calculation (openmrs/openmrs-module-calculation#19), legacyui and webservices.rest.

## Changes
- Build:
  - The module now builds against Platform 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT (with `openmrs-bom` imported), webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT and legacyui 3.0.0-SNAPSHOT.
  - Java 21 with `-parameters`.
  - jakarta servlet replaces javax.
  - mockito-inline, byte-buddy and the PowerMock exclusions are removed.
  - impsort 1.13.0, since 1.5.0 fails on Java 21; it gains a `jakarta` group.
  - `release.yml` uses Java 21.
- The api module no longer depends on `openmrs-web`, whose web test context broke the api tests.
- `config.xml` now sets `require_version` to 3.0.0.
- javax.persistence/validation imports become jakarta.
- DAO layer moves from Hibernate Criteria to JPA criteria:
  - `AbstractGenericDao` keeps the same join, voided/retired and unique-lookup semantics. `createOrUpdate` goes through `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate`, and `delete` uses `remove`.
  - `GenericDao.findByOr` / `findByAnd` now take `BiFunction<CriteriaBuilder, Root<W>, Predicate>`. `createCriteria()` is removed because its Hibernate `Criteria` type no longer exists.
  - `SearchQueryHandler.findCohorts` keeps case-insensitive `%name%` matching and distinct results. The attribute filter now joins `CohortAttributeType` explicitly. It used to always throw `could not resolve property: attributes`, so this filter now works.
- `@Where` becomes `@SQLRestriction`, with the same clause.
- `GenerationType.AUTO` and hbm `native` become `IDENTITY` / `identity`, matching core (TRUNK-6539). Without that, Hibernate 7 on MySQL expects `*_seq` tables that liquibase never creates.
- Attribute mappings:
  - Core 3.0's `BaseCustomizableData.attributes` is `mappedBy="owner"`, so the attribute hbm files gain a read-only `owner` many-to-one next to the existing `cohort` / `cohortMember` property.
  - `CohortMemberAttribute.attributeType` now maps to `cohort_member_attribute_type_id`, the column the module's liquibase actually creates. The old `attribute_type_id` mapping was never reachable until core 3.0 started loading `attributes` as a cascading collection; now it made cohort purge fail on MySQL.
- REST resources widen `supportedOpenmrsVersions` from `1.x - 2.*` to `1.x - 9.*`. Without that, every resource is "Unknown resource" on 3.0. The Swagger overrides are unchanged.
- Tests move to JUnit 5. In `CohortMemberGenericDaoTest`, a given-name search now returns 1 member instead of 2. On master the same member came back twice; Hibernate 7 de-duplicates root entities. The five "shouldCreateNew…" DAO tests no longer pre-assign ids, because Hibernate 7 rejects persisting an entity that already has one.

## Verification
- `mvn clean install` passes (api 62 tests, omod 55).
- I deployed the omod on openmrs-core master (`mvn jetty:run`, MySQL 8) with legacyui, webservices.rest 5.0.0-SNAPSHOT, calculation, fhir2 6.0.0-SNAPSHOT, htmlwidgets, idgen, event, stockmanagement, serialization.xstream, metadatamapping, attachments and teleconsultation:
  - All modules started, and the server log has no errors from this module.
  - Logging in through the UI works.
- Over REST:
  - `cohortm/cohort`, `cohorttype` and `cohortattributetype` list and search correctly.
  - Creating a cohort type and a cohort with a member works (201), and the cohort's member list shows the member.
  - Purging the cohort and the type both return 204.

title: Separate OWASP dependency check into its own job
body:
## Summary
- Separate OWASP dependency check into a standalone workflow job
- OWASP check only runs on push and workflow_dispatch (not on PRs)
- Build job no longer runs the OWASP check inline or needs the NVD_API_KEY secret

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify build job still passes
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check runs on push to the default branch
- [ ] Verify OWASP dependency check does not run on pull requests
